task.description:
Extend the design artefact at `src/design/definition.md` to cover PD-03 (Version management).

PD-03 requires that activating a DRAFT definition atomically sets the previously ACTIVE version of the same name to DEPRECATED (single transaction). Only DRAFT definitions may be activated; activating DEPRECATED or ARCHIVED definitions is rejected with HTTP 409. Activating the already-ACTIVE version of the same name is a no-op returning HTTP 200.

The design extension MUST include:
1. A new public function signature for `Store.activate` — parameters, return type, and error set.
2. The SQL transaction outline: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE the current ACTIVE row for the same name, UPDATE it to DEPRECATED, UPDATE the target row to ACTIVE — all in one transaction.
3. Updated DefinitionError set entries for: `already_active`, `not_draft`, `definition_not_found`.
4. A state transition table/diagram update showing DRAFT → ACTIVE (and side-effect: prior ACTIVE → DEPRECATED).
5. Traceability table mapping each PD-03 acceptance criterion to the design element that satisfies it.
6. Concurrency safety note: the SELECT ... FOR UPDATE ensures the atomic swap under concurrent activation requests.
acceptance_criteria: src/design/definition.md has been extended (not replaced) with a PD-03 section
Store.activate function signature is documented with full error set
SQL transaction outline covers the atomic DEPRECATED swap
All PD-03 acceptance criteria are traceable to design elements

result.summary: Extended src/design/definition.md with a PD-03 section. Added: Store.activate function signature (params: self *Store, allocator std.mem.Allocator, id Uuid; return: DefinitionError!Definition); extended DefinitionError set with AlreadyActive and NotDraft variants; four-step SQL transaction outline with SELECT…FOR UPDATE on target row and prior ACTIVE row, with DEPRECATED-before-ACTIVE ordering; updated state transition diagram and summary table; concurrency safety analysis for both same-id and same-name races; full traceability table for all seven PD-03 acceptance criteria. No implementation code written. All four handoff acceptance criteria met.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) to implement Store.activate in src/definition/store.zig
